#     - Coverage % = popcount(bit_vector) / total_cells, capped at 1.0

## Summary
Build the coverage heatmap API that traverses Neo4j to produce an 18x6 matrix (USMLE organ systems x Bloom levels) with 3-state coverage tracking (declared/delivered/confirmed) per cell, exposed via a GET endpoint for faculty dashboards.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to see a coverage heatmap of my course mapped to USMLE systems and Bloom levels, so that I can identify gaps in content coverage before building an exam blueprint.

## Why this matters
Without coverage data, faculty build exams blind — they cannot tell which USMLE systems or Bloom levels have zero approved items. This leads to exams that accidentally omit entire organ systems or cluster at a single cognitive level, jeopardizing LCME accreditation and USMLE Step 1 preparation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GET /api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=X returns 18 x 6 matrix with coverage states
- [ ] Each cell contains: { system, bloom, state: 'declared'|'delivered'|'confirmed', count, percentage }
- [ ] State logic: declared = SLO exists, delivered = content chunk teaches it, confirmed = approved assessment item covers it
- [ ] Only items connecting all three hubs (SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic) count as confirmed (D06)
- [ ] CoverageRecord reads use atomic Cypher expressions (Rule 11)
- [ ] All Neo4j queries use neo4jQuery wrapper (Rule 1)
- [ ] Response includes summary: { total_cells: 108, covered: N, coverage_pct: float }
- [ ] API returns 403 for non-faculty roles
- [ ] API returns 404 for nonexistent course_id

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for ALL Neo4j traversals — wrapper injects institution_id automatically |
| Rule 11 (C03) | CoverageRecord reads must be atomic Cypher — never read count, increment in JS, write back |
| D06 | Three-Hub Invariant — a cell is "confirmed" only if item connects SubConcept + SLO + USMLE_Subtopic |
| D02 | CoverageRecord progressive tracker — count/3 capped at 1.0 for coverage score |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Coverage data reads from Neo4j, but any writes go Supabase-first |

## Neo4j nodes created/modified
| Node type | Properties read | Created or modified? |
|---|---|---|
| USMLE_System | uuid, name, code | Read only |
| USMLE_Subtopic | uuid, name, system_id | Read only |
| BloomLevel | uuid, level (1-6), label | Read only |
| AssessmentItem | uuid, status, bloom_level | Read only |
| SubConcept | uuid, name | Read only |
| SLO | uuid, description | Read only |
| CoverageRecord | assessment_count, content_count | Read only (atomic) |

## Neo4j edges created/traversed
| Edge | From -> To | Properties | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| COVERS | AssessmentItem -> SubConcept | — | Item-to-knowledge-hub link |
| ALIGNS_TO | AssessmentItem -> SLO | — | Item-to-pedagogical-hub link |
| MAPPED_TO | AssessmentItem -> USMLE_Subtopic | — | Item-to-assessment-hub link |
| BELONGS_TO | USMLE_Subtopic -> USMLE_System | — | Subtopic rolls up to system |
| TEACHES | ContentChunk -> SubConcept | evidence_grade, evidence_weight | Content delivery evidence |
| CONTRIBUTES_TO | SLO -> ILO | — | Rule 8: SLO flows to ILO |

## Inngest event context

## API contract
```
GET /api/coverage/heatmap?course_id={uuid}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: {
  data: {
    course_id: string,
    matrix: Array<{
      system: { id: string, name: string, code: string },
      bloom: { level: number, label: string },
      state: 'none' | 'declared' | 'delivered' | 'confirmed',
      item_count: number,
      coverage_score: number  // count/3 capped at 1.0 (D02)
    }>,
    summary: {
      total_cells: 108,
      declared: number,
      delivered: number,
      confirmed: number,
      coverage_pct: number
    }
  },
  error: null
}
Error: { data: null, error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT_FOUND', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/coverage-blueprint/repositories/CoverageRepository.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'  // Rule 1 — ALWAYS

export class CoverageRepository {
  async getHeatmapMatrix(courseId: string): Promise<HeatmapCell[]> {
    // Single Cypher query that traverses all three hubs
    const result = await neo4jQuery<HeatmapCell[]>(`
      MATCH (ai:AssessmentItem)-[:COVERS]->(sc:SubConcept),
            (ai)-[:ALIGNS_TO]->(slo:SLO),
            (ai)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(st:USMLE_Subtopic)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(sys:USMLE_System)
      WHERE ai.course_id = $courseId AND ai.status = 'approved'
      WITH sys, ai.bloom_level AS bloom, count(ai) AS item_count
      RETURN sys.name AS system_name, sys.code AS system_code,
             bloom, item_count
      ORDER BY sys.code, bloom
    `, { courseId })
    return result
  }

  // Rule 11: atomic read of CoverageRecord
  async getCoverageScore(courseId: string, systemCode: string, bloom: number): Promise<number> {
    const result = await neo4jQuery<{ score: number }[]>(`
      MATCH (cr:CoverageRecord {course_id: $courseId, system_code: $systemCode, bloom: $bloom})
      RETURN CASE WHEN cr.assessment_count >= 3 THEN 1.0
                  ELSE toFloat(cr.assessment_count) / 3.0
             END AS score
    `, { courseId, systemCode, bloom })
    return result[0]?.score ?? 0
  }
}
```

const newCount = count + 1                        // modify in JS

// ✗ D06 violation: counting items that don't connect all three hubs

// Missing ALIGNS_TO SLO and MAPPED_TO USMLE_Subtopic — item is incomplete

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S01.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

test('Acceptance: GET /api/coverage/heatmap returns 18x6 matrix', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.summary.total_cells).toBe(108)
  expect(data.matrix.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  // Every cell must have valid state
  for (const cell of data.matrix) {
    expect(['none', 'declared', 'delivered', 'confirmed']).toContain(cell.state)
    expect(cell.coverage_score).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
    expect(cell.coverage_score).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1.0)
  }
})

test('Acceptance: confirmed cells only count three-hub items', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  const confirmed = data.matrix.filter((c: any) => c.state === 'confirmed')
  // All confirmed cells must have item_count > 0
  for (const cell of confirmed) {
    expect(cell.item_count).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  }
})

test('Acceptance: coverage_score is count/3 capped at 1.0', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  const { data } = await res.json()
  for (const cell of data.matrix) {
    if (cell.item_count > 0) {
      const expected = Math.min(cell.item_count / 3, 1.0)
      expect(cell.coverage_score).toBeCloseTo(expected, 2)
    }
  }
})

test('Negative: non-faculty gets 403', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_STUDENT_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403)
})

test('Negative: nonexistent course_id gets 404', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(404)
})
```
